name: dw1240-1118 (Hubble)
blurb: dw1240-1118, a dwarf galaxy candidate near the Sombrero Galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: dw12401118-hubble
story: A faint dwarf spheroidal galaxy that probably belongs to the family of the Sombrero Galaxy. Hubble is imaging satellites like this one around Milky Way-like galaxies to test how well cosmological models work on small scales.

claims.text: dw1240-1118 is a dwarf galaxy candidate in the M104 (Sombrero) system with high membership probability
Its morphology is a dwarf spheroidal (dSph)
It is a target of the Hubble Census of Nearby Satellites (program 18061)
The program surveys satellites of Milky Way-like systems to test cosmological models on small scales
